title: Delete device via context menu
description: Right-click a device to delete it (with confirm), removing attached wires and marking dirty.

notes.content: Implemented delete action on device context menu with confirmation; deletion removes attached wires, updates scene lists, and marks dirty.

title: Delete pin via context menu
description: Right-click a pin to delete it (with confirm), removing attached wires, re-laying pins, and marking dirty.

notes.content: Implemented pin delete action with confirmation; removes attached wires, updates model/layout, and marks dirty. Added regression test.

title: Delete wire via context menu
description: Right-click a wire to delete it and mark dirty.

notes.content: Implemented wire delete action on context menu with confirmation; deletes from scene, detaches from devices, updates lists, and marks dirty. Added regression test.

title: Change wire color via context menu
description: Right-click a wire to pick a color (palette or dialog), update model/pen, and mark dirty.

notes.content: Added wire color context menu with DIN 47100 palette and custom picker; updates model color, refreshes pen, and marks dirty. Added regression test.

title: Save dialog should add .yaml extension
description: File save dialog does not append .yaml automatically; ensure saved files get the .yaml suffix by default.

notes.content: Added .yaml suffix enforcement via save-as; keeps .yml, appends .yaml when missing; added regression test and Path normalization.

title: Wire metadata inheritance from pins
description: Allow wires to carry metadata that inherits or aggregates attributes from the connected pins (e.g., function, signal type).

notes.content: Added pin and wire meta fields; wire creation merges pin meta (end pin overrides); regression tests cover merge behavior.

title: Draw twisted pair
description: Provide a drawing/visualization option for twisted pair wires, including coupled rendering and metadata to mark pairs.

notes.content: Implemented twisted-pair rendering: Wire model supports twisted flag/pair_id; context menu toggle; dual-path overlay with alternating offset and styled tooltip row.

title: Segment handle drag oscillation
description: Dragging rectangular line-segment grips sometimes jitters/oscillates away from the cursor (same behavior as issue 15 but for segment handles).

notes.content: Related visual artifact (orphaned white circle) traced to an implicit bundle handle; implicit handle removed and tests added to guard against stray ellipses. This may reduce occurrences of perceived oscillation in some workflows.

Temporarily marked staging per project policy: AI Agents must move completed items to 'staging' for human review before marking 'resolved'. Changes were pushed to main for a quick fix, but human review is required to transition to 'resolved'. (Commits referenced: 61a31af, f83c30a)

title: Twisted Pair: middle & elbow grips parity
description: Make twisted pair wires expose middle grips and elbow grips identical to regular wires so users can add/move/delete elbows and create segment grips.

title: Twisted Pair: end behaves as pseudo-elbow
description: Treat the end of a twisted pair as a selectable/pivotable pseudo-elbow so the wire end can be dragged and used as a pivot similar to regular wire ends.

title: Suppress pin context menu for Twisted Pair pins
description: Prevent right-click pin context menu on pins that belong to a Twisted Pair since their attributes inherit from connected wires and should not be edited directly.

title: Color inheritance on connect across Twisted Pair
description: When a wire is connected to one end of a Twisted Pair, wires on the other end should inherit color/metadata from the original connecting wire.

title: Propagate color changes to all connecting wires and pins
description: Changing the color of a wire connected to either end of a Twisted Pair should update all connected wires and the device pin visual colors to maintain consistency.

title: Rename Bundle → TwistedPair
description: Rename code and UI references from 'bundle' to 'twisted pair' (TwistedPair) to reflect the tool's intended use and reserve 'bundle' for larger multi-wire bundles later.

title: Add TwistedPair unit tests
description: Add unit tests for grips, pseudo-elbow behavior, pin context suppression, color inheritance, propagation, persistence, and rename coverage.

title: Persistence migration for TwistedPair model
description: Update persistence / loading code and migration steps to reflect TwistedPair renames and ensure backwards compatibility with existing 'bundle' entries.

title: Stray implicit bundle handle causes orphaned circle
description: An implicit ellipse handle was present on TwistedBundle creation which could appear as a detached white circle during edits. The implicit handle was removed in favor of explicit ElbowHandle items created by the user.

notes.content: Removed implicit handle from TwistedBundleItem; added unit tests to assert no stray ellipse at bundle creation and updated behavior to use explicit ElbowHandle items. Full test suite passes locally (83 tests).
Commit 61a31af pushed to main (alpha): changes merged directly to main per alpha workflow. Tests still pass on CI runner locally.
